about_short_description.short_description: Gulf Marine Services is a operator of self-propelled and self-elevating support vessels.

product.name: E-Class Self-Propelled Lift Boats
product.description: Self-propelled, self-elevating jackup barges with up to 400t crane capacity, operating in water depths up to 80m, providing accommodation and support for offshore oil, gas, and renewable energy sectors.

product.name: S-Class Self-Propelled Lift Boats
product.description: Self-propelled, self-elevating jackup barges with up to 150t crane capacity, operating in water depths up to 55m, offering accommodation and support for offshore oil, gas, and renewable energy projects.

product.name: K-Class Self-Propelled Lift Boats
product.description: Self-propelled, self-elevating jackup barges with up to 45t crane capacity, operating in water depths up to 45m, providing accommodation and support for offshore oil, gas, and renewable energy operations.

product.name: Plug and Abandonment Solutions
product.description: Services using cantilever-equipped vessels to perform well plugging and abandonment, enhancing safety and reducing costs in decommissioning offshore oil and gas fields.
